summary: Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted PDF toolkit server; the OSS core does stateless PDF processing (merge/split/convert/OCR) while the enterprise (proprietary+saas) layer adds persisted business state: file storage (StoredFile/Folder/FileShare), user/team/auth (User/Team/ApiKey/Invite), document workflows/signing, policy/source pipelines, account-link, and SaaS usage-based billing (PAYG wallet/processing jobs) all backed by JPA entities with CRUD controllers and role/ownership guards.
